regions.today: \n\nA pleasant summer's day with long spells of sunshine - just the slight chance of a light shower to begin. Top temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees, warmest further east, in just light westerly or variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and calm with clear spells. Patches of mist and fog will form. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Sunday will be rather warm with long spells of sunshine, turning hazy later. Top temperatures of 19 to 24 degrees, best values further west, in a mostly light easterly breeze.
